article.title: Punishment for public nuisance in cases not otherwise provided for
article.content: Whoever commits a public nuisance in any case not otherwise punishable by this Sanhita shall be punished with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.
article.html:
292Punishment for public nuisance in cases not otherwise provided for

Section 292 · Chapter XV

Whoever commits a public nuisance in any case not otherwise punishable by this Sanhita shall be punished with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.
